title: Keep `services` empty and build no services section: availability lives in the last paragraph of identity.summary.long
body: Decided by the author 2026-10-29: no services catalogue. The author takes any web development job, employed or freelance, and a list of three services would turn away the fourth. That availability, plus location (Rosario), remote/hybrid and what the author looks for, is written in the LAST paragraph of `identity.summary.long` in content/data/content.es.json (English mirror in content.en.json). Consequences: `services` stays `[]` (do not seed it with placeholders), there is no price range to define because there is no service to price, and a "Servicios" landing section is not pending work. The `Service` interface in content/schema/content-schema.ts stays only so nothing has to be migrated if this changes. What IS still open is where that last summary paragraph renders (an About section).
not_derivable: An empty services array and an unused Service type look like unfinished work; the code cannot say the catalogue was rejected or where the availability text lives instead.

evidence.summary: services is []; summary.long ends with 'Tomo cualquier trabajo de desarrollo web, en relación de dependencia o freelance.'
